mapper.select: SELECT es.id, es.student_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, es.submission_date AS submissionDate, es.time_taken AS timeTaken, es.score, es.teacher_comment AS teacherComment, es.graded FROM exam_submissions es JOIN users u ON es.student_id = u.id WHERE es.exam_id = #{examId}

SELECT DISTINCT e.id, e.title, e.description, e.course_id AS courseId, e.start_time AS startTime, e.end_time AS endTime, e.publish_date AS publishDate, e.is_active AS isActive, e.is_online AS isOnline, e.location, e.duration, e.teacher_id AS teacherId FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}
